name: The Old Pyethymer Place
summary: A house at the end of the east lane that children go into and do not come out of.

stages.journal: At the end of the east lane stands the Old Pyethymer Place, chained shut by order of the mayor, with a child's shoe on its step.
stages.hint: Look at the gate at the end of the east lane.

stages.journal: The house is shut for a reason, and it is not a house for a party our size. It will be waiting.
stages.hint: Come back when you are stronger; the gate will still be chained.
